comments: Tap-to-call / sms / WhatsApp links; see plh-kids-teens-app-mx-content#132

rows.name: intro
rows.value: Tap each link and note what happens. **Do not press call or send**: only check which app opens and what it shows. All numbers are fake.
rows.comments: Context: plh-kids-teens-app-mx-content#132 (tap to call for support contacts)

rows.name: title_markdown
rows.comments: How authors could add tap-to-call to the current support pages

rows.name: tel_basic
rows.comments: Expected: dialer opens with the number filled in

rows.name: tel_hyphens
rows.comments: Expected: dialer; hyphens allowed in tel: links

rows.name: tel_spaces
rows.value:
A4. [📞 55 0000 0000](tel:55 0000 0000)
Expect: NOT a link (spaces are not allowed in the address part)
rows.comments: Authoring mistake case: shows what happens if authors keep spaces in the number

rows.name: tel_ussd_encoded
rows.value:
A5. [📞 \*120\*0000#](tel:*120*0000%23)
Expect: dialer opens with *120*0000# (USSD, # written as %23)

rows.name: tel_ussd_raw
rows.value:
A6. [📞 \*120\*0000# (raw #)](tel:*120*0000#)
Expect: dialer may drop the # and show *120*0000
rows.comments: Same as A5 but with a raw #, to see if the encoding is needed

rows.name: sms_basic
rows.value:
A7. [💬 SMS 0000000000](sms:0000000000)
Expect: messaging app opens with the number

rows.name: sms_body
rows.value:
A8. [💬 SMS with text](sms:0000000000?body=Hola)
Expect: messaging app with the number and the text Hola

rows.name: whatsapp
rows.value:
A9. [💬 WhatsApp](https://wa.me/5215500000000)
Expect: WhatsApp (or the wa.me page) opens; it may say the number isn't on WhatsApp

rows.name: mailto
rows.value:
A10. [✉️ Email](mailto:test@example.com)
Expect: email app opens to test@example.com

rows.name: plain_number
rows.value:
A11. Plain number, no link: 📞 0000000000
Expect: not tappable (control)
rows.comments: How numbers are written on the support pages today
